source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.3.3 (PDF 133, printed 130).

blocks.text: Data cleaning (safai) aur transformation (shakal badalna) data ko analysis ke liye tayyar karne ke aham qadam hain. Kachche (raw) data mein aksar ghaltiyan, ghayab qeematein ya ghalat format hota hai. Durust nataij ke liye zaroori hai ke aage barhne se pehle yeh masail theek kiye jayein.

blocks.prompt: Analysis se pehle data saaf karna kyun zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: Ghaltiyan, khali jagahein aur dohraye hue (duplicate) records nataij ko gumrah kun (misleading) bana dete hain.

items: Kachcha data analysis se pehle saaf karein aur munasib shakal mein badlein.
